title: Latest fixes
body:
## Holidays and micro-holidays

### Feast of Winter Veil

- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: Legion assault outposts no longer appear during the feast.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: Love is in the Air decorations no longer hang during the feast.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: the Burning Steppes adventure board stays all year.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: 173 stacked decorations and 3 stacked revelers removed.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: snow clouds and townsfolk of the capitals spawned.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: presents under the trees only on Winter Veil morning.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: feast quests offered only during the feast.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: Treats for Greatfather Winter only after meeting him.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: Metzen the Reindeer offered again, which unblocks The Hero of the Day.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: the yearly gifts come back every year.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: dialogue of the Smokywood Pastures vendors, Great-father Winter and the Wonderform Operator.
- **[Fix]** DB/Winter Veil: Mankrik stays in the Barrens all year.
- **[Fix]** DB/Holidays: Lillian Singh sells her fireworks at the Fireworks Spectacular, not at Winter Veil.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Toys: the Mechanical Greench follows and protects its owner.
- **[Change]** Hotfixes/Achievements: Don't Play With That In The House no longer names 2017.

### Volunteer Guard Day

- **[Fix]** Scripts/Volunteer Guard Day: the guard disguise follows the player's gender.
- **[Fix]** DB/Volunteer Guard Day: invaders match the volunteer's level.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Volunteer Guard Day: townsfolk flee from the invaders.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Volunteer Guard Day: no invaders while the volunteer is dead.

### Thousand Boat Bash

- **[Fix]** Scripts/Thousand Boat Bash: the boat leaves with the festival and outside Thousand Needles.

### Other holidays

- **[Fix]** DB/Holidays: Alliance commoners offer the Hallow's End, Midsummer and Pilgrim's Bounty invitations only during their holiday.
- **[Fix]** DB/Midsummer: the Desolace Flame Warden only stands by his bonfire during the festival.

## Cities

### Ironforge

- **[Fix]** DB/Ironforge: guards, thief catchers and walking townsfolk follow their rounds.
- **[Fix]** DB/Ironforge: gryphon riders fly their routes, their wingmen in formation.

## Toys

- **[Fix]** Core/Toys: a new balloon replaces the one held (Green, Yellow and Flimsy Yellow Balloon).
- **[Fix]** Core/Toys: the Adopted Puppy Crate lets out its four puppies, which run around.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Toys: the Brazier of Dancing Flames keeps dancing.
- **[Fix]** DB/Toys: the Star Chart floats above its stand.
- **[Fix]** DB/Toys: Archmage Vargoth can be spoken to.
- **[Fix]** DB/Toys: French name of the War Party Hitching Post.

## Data and technical

- **[Change]** Scripts/Commands: `.additem` adds several items at once, from links or from ids joined by commas.
